macros.name: ifstandalone
macros.doc: Both the class and the package provide the if-switch \ifstandalone, which can be used to only include code if the file is compiled standalone.

macros.name: IfStandalone
macros.doc: This is the macro version of the \ifstandalone if-switch. It executes the first argument only in standalone mode, i.e. when the file is compiled on its own.

macros.name: ifstandalonebeamer
macros.doc: Both the class and the package provide the if-switch \ifstandalonebeamer, which can be used to only include code if the file is compiled standalone with the beamer class option set.

macros.name: includestandalone
macros.doc: This sophisticated macro can be used instead of \input to include standalone files.

macros.name: standaloneconfig
macros.doc: This configuration macro accepts the class options described in section 5.2.

envs.name: standaloneframe
envs.doc: It will be equal to frame in standalone mode, but without effect otherwise.
